```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(leaflet)
library(glue)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(here)
library(crosstalk)
library(htmltools)
library(jsonlite)

# Colors: all points look the same *except* archived ones get a distinct color
default_color <- "#41546a"
archive_color <- "#A5CF6A"

all_data <- read_csv(here("data/studies.csv")) |>
  filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon))

# --- Jiggle points that share the exact same coordinates so overlapping ---
# markers (e.g. co-located studies) are all individually visible/clickable.
set.seed(42)
jitter_amount <- 0.003  # ~ a few hundred meters at MN latitudes

all_data <- all_data |>
  group_by(lat, lon) |>
  mutate(
    n_at_location = n(),
    jitter_idx = row_number()
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    angle = 2 * pi * (jitter_idx - 1) / pmax(n_at_location, 1),
    lat = if_else(n_at_location > 1, lat + jitter_amount * sin(angle), lat),
    lon = if_else(n_at_location > 1, lon + jitter_amount * cos(angle), lon)
  ) |>
  select(-n_at_location, -jitter_idx, -angle) |>
  mutate(row_key = as.character(row_number()))  # stable crosstalk / marker key

# --- Build one combined popup per project. The species (from the `species`
# column) is shown once, right under the title, then a section per source
# is added only if that project actually has data from that source.
build_popup <- function(row) {

  title <- coalesce(row$movebank_name, row$lccmr_name, "Untitled Study")
  header <- glue("<b>{title}</b>")
  if (!is.na(row$species) && nzchar(row$species)) {
    header <- glue("{header}<br><i>{row$species}</i>")
  }
  sections <- header

  # Movebank section (only if this project has a Movebank record)
  if (!is.na(row$movebank_id)) {
    sections <- c(sections, glue(
      "<u>Movebank</u><br>",
      "Contact: {coalesce(row$movebank_contact, 'Unknown')}<br>",
      "Start Date: {coalesce(format(row$movebank_timestamp_first_deployed_location, '%Y-%m-%d'), 'Unknown')}<br>",
      "Latest Date: {coalesce(format(row$movebank_timestamp_last_deployed_location, '%Y-%m-%d'), 'Unknown')}<br>",
      "Sensors: {coalesce(row$movebank_sensor_type_ids, 'Unknown')}<br>",
      "Individuals: {coalesce(as.character(row$movebank_number_of_individuals), 'Unknown')}<br>",
      "<a href='{row$movebank_url}' target='_blank'>View on Movebank</a>"
    ))
  }

  # Motus section (only if this project has a Motus record)
  if (!is.na(row$motus_id)) {
    sections <- c(sections, glue(
      "<u>Motus</u><br>",
      "Contact: {coalesce(row$motus_contact, 'Unknown')}<br>",
      "Start Date: {coalesce(format(row$motus_creation_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), 'Unknown')}<br>",
      "Receivers in MN: {coalesce(as.character(row$motus_n_receivers), 'Unknown')}<br>",
      "<a href='{row$motus_url}' target='_blank'>View on Motus</a>"
    ))
  }

  # LCCMR section (only if this project has at least one related grant;
  # a project can have more than one LCCMR grant, so split & list them all)
  if (!is.na(row$lccmr_ids)) {
    ids      <- str_split(row$lccmr_ids, "\\s*;\\s*")[[1]]
    names    <- str_split(row$lccmr_name, "\\s*;\\s*")[[1]]
    urls     <- str_split(row$lccmr_urls, "\\s*;\\s*")[[1]]
    contacts <- str_split(row$lccmr_contact, "\\s*;\\s*")[[1]]
    lccmr_start_dates <- str_split(row$lccmr_start_date, "\\s*;\\s*")[[1]]
    lccmr_end_dates <- str_split(row$lccmr_end_date, "\\s*;\\s*")[[1]]


    grants <- pmap_chr(list(ids, names, urls, contacts,
                            lccmr_start_dates, lccmr_end_dates), 
                       function(id, nm, url, contact, lccmr_start_date, lccmr_end_date) {
      glue("&bull; <a href='{url}' target='_blank'>{id}</a> &ndash; {nm}<br>",
           "&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Contact: {coalesce(contact, 'Unknown')} <br>",
           "&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Start Date: {coalesce(format(lccmr_start_date), 'Unknown')}<br>",
           "&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;End Date: {coalesce(format(lccmr_end_date), 'Unknown')}")
    })

    label <- if (length(ids) > 1) "LCCMR Grants" else "LCCMR Grant"
    sections <- c(sections, glue(
      "<u>{label}</u><br>{paste(grants, collapse = '<br>')}"
    ))
  }

  paste(sections, collapse = "<hr style='margin:4px 0'>")
}

popup_htmls <- map_chr(seq_len(nrow(all_data)), \(i) build_popup(all_data[i, ]))

# --- Per-row "Sources" HTML: one linked badge per source the study has ---
# (Movebank / Motus / LCCMR), each pointing at its own URL, same as the popup.
build_sources_html <- function(row) {
  parts <- c()

  if (!is.na(row$movebank_id)) {
    parts <- c(parts, glue("<a href='{row$movebank_url}' target='_blank'>Movebank</a>"))
  }

  if (!is.na(row$motus_id)) {
    parts <- c(parts, glue("<a href='{row$motus_url}' target='_blank'>Motus</a>"))
  }

  if (!is.na(row$lccmr_ids)) {
    urls <- str_split(row$lccmr_urls, "\\s*;\\s*")[[1]]
    if (length(urls) <= 1) {
      parts <- c(parts, glue("<a href='{urls[1]}' target='_blank'>LCCMR</a>"))
    } else {
      lccmr_links <- map_chr(seq_along(urls),
                              \(i) glue("<a href='{urls[i]}' target='_blank'>LCCMR {i}</a>"))
      parts <- c(parts, paste(lccmr_links, collapse = ", "))
    }
  }

  paste(parts, collapse = ", ")
}

sources_htmls <- map_chr(seq_len(nrow(all_data)), \(i) build_sources_html(all_data[i, ]))

# --- Earliest year across whichever date fields a study has ---
get_year_started <- function(row) {
  dates <- as.Date(character(0))

  if (!is.na(row$movebank_timestamp_first_deployed_location)) {
    dates <- c(dates, as.Date(row$movebank_timestamp_first_deployed_location))
  }
  if (!is.na(row$motus_creation_date)) {
    dates <- c(dates, as.Date(row$motus_creation_date))
  }
  if (!is.na(row$lccmr_start_date)) {
    lccmr_dates <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(str_split(row$lccmr_start_date, "\\s*;\\s*")[[1]]))
    dates <- c(dates, lccmr_dates[!is.na(lccmr_dates)])
  }

  if (length(dates) == 0) return(NA_integer_)
  as.integer(format(min(dates), "%Y"))
}

year_started <- map_int(seq_len(nrow(all_data)), \(i) get_year_started(all_data[i, ]))

all_data <- all_data |>
  mutate(
    popup_html = popup_htmls,
    sources_html = sources_htmls,
    year_started = year_started,
    is_archive = !is.na(in_mama_archive),
    has_lccmr  = !is.na(lccmr_ids),
    has_motus  = !is.na(motus_id),
    has_movebank = !is.na(movebank_id),
    point_color = if_else(is_archive, archive_color, default_color),
    border_weight = if_else(is_archive, 3, 1),
    archive_filter  = if_else(is_archive,   "MN Archive", NA_character_),
    lccmr_filter    = if_else(has_lccmr,    "LCCMR", NA_character_),
    motus_filter    = if_else(has_motus,    "Motus", NA_character_),
    movebank_filter = if_else(has_movebank, "Movebank", NA_character_)
  ) |>
  arrange(in_mama_archive)

# Explicit key + group so the search box, checkboxes, and table all drive/
# read the same crosstalk filter.
shared_data <- SharedData$new(all_data, key = ~row_key, group = "mama_studies")

# layerId = ~row_key lets JS individually add/remove a single study's marker
# later (for the per-row map-selection checkboxes), independent of the
# crosstalk search/checkbox filtering.
map <- leaflet(shared_data, width = "100%", height = "650px", elementId = "mama-map") |>
  setView(lng = -93.18743447478747, lat = 46.08212830771725, zoom = 6.4) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
    layerId = ~row_key,
    radius = 6,
    color = "#333333",
    weight = ~border_weight,
    fillColor = ~point_color,
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    stroke = TRUE,
    popup = ~popup_html
  )

# Checkbox filters, styled as pill-shaped toggles. label = "" on each
# filter_checkbox suppresses crosstalk's default heading (which otherwise
# duplicates the checkbox's own text), and mama-filter-panel-scoped CSS
# below restyles the checkboxes themselves.
filter_panel <- tagList(
  tags$style(HTML("
    .mama-filter-panel { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 12px 0 6px 0; }
    .mama-filter-panel .mama-filter-label { font-weight: 600; color: #444; font-size: 13px; margin-right: 4px; }
    .mama-filter-panel .control-label { display: none; }
    .mama-filter-panel .crosstalk-input-checkboxgroup { margin: 0; }
    .mama-filter-panel .crosstalk-options-group { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .mama-filter-panel .checkbox { margin: 0; }
    .mama-filter-panel .checkbox label {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
      padding: 5px 14px; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 999px;
      background-color: #f7f7f5; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500;
      cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
    }
    .mama-filter-panel .checkbox label:hover { background-color: #ebebe6; border-color: #999; }
    .mama-filter-panel .checkbox input[type='checkbox'] { width: 14px; height: 14px; margin: 0; accent-color: #41546a; }
  ")),
  tags$div(
    class = "mama-filter-panel",
    tags$span(class = "mama-filter-label", "Filter:"),
    filter_checkbox("archive_filter", "", shared_data, ~archive_filter),
    filter_checkbox("lccmr_filter", "", shared_data, ~lccmr_filter),
    filter_checkbox("motus_filter", "", shared_data, ~motus_filter),
    filter_checkbox("movebank_filter", "", shared_data, ~movebank_filter)
  )
)

# --- Table + search data prep -------------------------------------------
# Species and contact now come straight from their own dedicated columns
# (scientific names / de-duplicated contact list) rather than being
# re-derived from the raw movebank_*/motus_*/lccmr_* fields per row.
table_data <- all_data |>
  transmute(
    row_key,
    title        = coalesce(movebank_name, lccmr_name, "Untitled Study"),
    year_started,
    contact      = coalesce(contact, ""),
    species      = coalesce(species, ""),
    sources_html,
    sources_text = str_replace_all(sources_html, "<[^>]+>", ""),  # plain text, for sort
    archive      = if_else(is_archive, "Yes", "No")
  )

# Full searchable text blob per row (used by Fuse.js; not displayed directly).
# Fuse always searches this complete index regardless of table pagination.
search_text <- all_data |>
  transmute(
    row_key,
    text = paste(movebank_name, lccmr_name, contact, species, lccmr_ids) |>
      str_replace_all("\\bNA\\b", "") |>
      str_squish()
  )

search_index <- table_data |>
  left_join(search_text, by = "row_key") |>
  transmute(key = row_key, title, text)

search_json <- toJSON(search_index, auto_unbox = TRUE) |>
  as.character() |>
  str_replace_all("</", "<\\\\/")  # avoid premature </script> termination

# Build the results table as raw HTML, one <tr> per study with a data-key
# attribute so JS can show/hide rows to match the active crosstalk filter,
# and a data-sort attribute per cell so column headers can be click-sorted.
# First column is a map-selection checkbox, second is a row number kept in
# sync with current sort/filter/pagination by JS. All rows are always
# rendered in the HTML; JS shows only the current page's slice of whatever
# currently matches the search/filter.
table_row_html <- function(r) {
  year_display <- if (is.na(r$year_started)) "" else as.character(r$year_started)
  year_sort    <- if (is.na(r$year_started)) "" else as.character(r$year_started)
  archive_sort <- if (r$archive == "Yes") "1" else "0"

  glue(
    "<tr data-key='{r$row_key}'>",
    "<td style='text-align:center;'><input type='checkbox' class='mama-row-select' data-key='{r$row_key}' checked></td>",
    "<td class='mama-row-num' style='color:#888;'></td>",
    "<td data-sort='{tolower(r$title)}'>{htmltools::htmlEscape(r$title)}</td>",
    "<td data-sort='{year_sort}'>{year_display}</td>",
    "<td data-sort='{tolower(r$contact)}'>{htmltools::htmlEscape(r$contact)}</td>",
    "<td data-sort='{tolower(r$species)}'><i>{htmltools::htmlEscape(r$species)}</i></td>",
    "<td data-sort='{tolower(r$sources_text)}'>{r$sources_html}</td>",
    "<td data-sort='{archive_sort}'>{r$archive}</td>",
    "</tr>"
  )
}

table_rows_html <- map_chr(seq_len(nrow(table_data)), \(i) table_row_html(table_data[i, ]))

results_table <- HTML(glue(
  "<table id='mama-results-table' style='width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:13px;'>",
  "<thead><tr style='text-align:left; border-bottom:2px solid #333;'>",
  "<th style='padding:6px 8px; text-align:center;'><input type='checkbox' id='mama-select-all' checked title='Show/hide all on map'></th>",
  "<th style='padding:6px 8px;'>#</th>",
  "<th data-col='2' class='mama-sortable' style='padding:6px 8px; cursor:pointer;'>Study</th>",
  "<th data-col='3' class='mama-sortable' style='padding:6px 8px; cursor:pointer;'>Year Started</th>",
  "<th data-col='4' class='mama-sortable' style='padding:6px 8px; cursor:pointer;'>Contact</th>",
  "<th data-col='5' class='mama-sortable' style='padding:6px 8px; cursor:pointer;'>Species</th>",
  "<th data-col='6' class='mama-sortable' style='padding:6px 8px; cursor:pointer;'>Sources</th>",
  "<th data-col='7' class='mama-sortable' style='padding:6px 8px; cursor:pointer;'>In Archive</th>",
  "</tr></thead>",
  "<tbody>{paste(table_rows_html, collapse = '')}</tbody>",
  "</table>"
))

pagination_bar <- tagList(
  tags$style(HTML("
    .mama-pagination { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 10px; font-size: 13px; }
    .mama-pagination button {
      padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px;
      background-color: #f7f7f5; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px;
    }
    .mama-pagination button:hover:not(:disabled) { background-color: #ebebe6; border-color: #999; }
    .mama-pagination button:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; }
    .mama-pagination select { padding: 3px 6px; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13px; }
  ")),
  tags$div(
    class = "mama-pagination",
    tags$button(id = "mama-page-prev", type = "button", "\u2039 Prev"),
    tags$span(id = "mama-page-indicator", "Page 1"),
    tags$button(id = "mama-page-next", type = "button", "Next \u203a"),
    tags$span(style = "margin-left:auto; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;",
      "Rows per page:",
      tags$select(id = "mama-page-size",
        tags$option(value = "10", "10"),
        tags$option(value = "15", selected = "selected", "15"),
        tags$option(value = "25", "25"),
        tags$option(value = "50", "50"),
        tags$option(value = "999999", "All")
      )
    )
  )
)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
tags$script(HTML("
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    var records = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('mama-search-data').textContent);
    var fuse = new Fuse(records, { keys: ['title', 'text'], threshold: 0.35, ignoreLocation: true });
    var input = document.getElementById('mama-search-input');
    var countEl = document.getElementById('mama-search-count');
    var filterHandle = new crosstalk.FilterHandle('mama_studies');
    var allKeys = records.map(function(r) { return r.key; });

    // filterMatchKeys is the FULL set of studies that currently match the
    // search box / archive-lccmr-motus-movebank checkboxes above (i.e. the
    // complete filtered list). Fuse always searches the entire `records`
    // array above, never just the current page, so filtering/search always
    // covers the full dataset -- pagination only affects what's rendered.
    var filterMatchKeys = new Set(allKeys);
    var pageSize = 15;
    var currentPage = 1;

    var pageIndicator = document.getElementById('mama-page-indicator');
    var prevBtn = document.getElementById('mama-page-prev');
    var nextBtn = document.getElementById('mama-page-next');
    var pageSizeSelect = document.getElementById('mama-page-size');

    function getAllRows() {
      return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#mama-results-table tbody tr'));
    }

    // Applies filterMatchKeys + currentPage/pageSize to decide which rows
    // are actually rendered. Row numbers are continuous across pages (i.e.
    // page 2 continues at 16, 17, ... rather than restarting at 1).
    function refreshTable() {
      var rows = getAllRows();
      var visible = rows.filter(function(tr) {
        return filterMatchKeys.has(tr.getAttribute('data-key'));
      });
      var total = visible.length;
      var totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / pageSize));
      if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = totalPages;
      if (currentPage < 1) currentPage = 1;
      var start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
      var end = start + pageSize;

      rows.forEach(function(tr) {
        tr.style.display = 'none';
        var numCell = tr.querySelector('.mama-row-num');
        if (numCell) numCell.textContent = '';
      });
      visible.forEach(function(tr, idx) {
        if (idx >= start && idx < end) {
          tr.style.display = '';
          var numCell = tr.querySelector('.mama-row-num');
          if (numCell) numCell.textContent = idx + 1;
        }
      });

      if (countEl) {
        if (total === 0) {
          countEl.textContent = '0 of ' + allKeys.length + ' studies shown';
        } else {
          var firstShown = start + 1;
          var lastShown = Math.min(end, total);
          countEl.textContent = 'Showing ' + firstShown + '\\u2013' + lastShown +
            ' of ' + total + ' studies' +
            (total !== allKeys.length ? ' (filtered from ' + allKeys.length + ')' : '');
        }
      }
      if (pageIndicator) pageIndicator.textContent = 'Page ' + currentPage + ' of ' + totalPages;
      if (prevBtn) prevBtn.disabled = currentPage <= 1;
      if (nextBtn) nextBtn.disabled = currentPage >= totalPages;

      // crosstalk may have redrawn the map's markers since the last filter
      // change; re-apply any manual per-row map deselections on top of that.
      setTimeout(applyDeselections, 50);
    }

    if (prevBtn) prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { currentPage--; refreshTable(); });
    if (nextBtn) nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { currentPage++; refreshTable(); });
    if (pageSizeSelect) {
      pageSizeSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
        pageSize = parseInt(pageSizeSelect.value, 10);
        currentPage = 1;
        refreshTable();
      });
    }

    // --- Per-row map-selection checkboxes ---------------------------------
    // Independent of the crosstalk search/checkbox filter above: this only
    // controls which markers are actually attached to the Leaflet map, via
    // each marker's layerId (set to row_key in R). Because crosstalk redraws
    // markers from scratch whenever its own filter changes, we rebuild our
    // key->layer lookup and reapply deselections every time that happens.
    var deselected = new Set();   // row_keys the user has unchecked
    var layerByKey = {};

    function getLeafletMap() {
      var widget = window.HTMLWidgets && HTMLWidgets.find('#mama-map');
      return widget ? widget.getMap() : null;
    }

    function rebuildLayerIndex() {
      var leafletMap = getLeafletMap();
      if (!leafletMap) return null;
      layerByKey = {};
      leafletMap.eachLayer(function(layer) {
        if (layer.options && layer.options.layerId) {
          layerByKey[layer.options.layerId] = layer;
        }
      });
      return leafletMap;
    }

    function applyDeselections() {
      var leafletMap = rebuildLayerIndex();
      if (!leafletMap) return;
      deselected.forEach(function(key) {
        var layer = layerByKey[key];
        if (layer && leafletMap.hasLayer(layer)) {
          leafletMap.removeLayer(layer);
        }
      });
    }

    function setRowSelected(key, selected) {
      var leafletMap = getLeafletMap();
      if (selected) {
        deselected.delete(key);
        if (leafletMap) {
          var layer = layerByKey[key];
          if (layer && !leafletMap.hasLayer(layer)) leafletMap.addLayer(layer);
        }
      } else {
        deselected.add(key);
        if (leafletMap) {
          var layer = layerByKey[key];
          if (layer && leafletMap.hasLayer(layer)) leafletMap.removeLayer(layer);
        }
      }
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.mama-row-select').forEach(function(cb) {
      cb.addEventListener('change', function() {
        setRowSelected(cb.getAttribute('data-key'), cb.checked);
      });
    });

    var selectAll = document.getElementById('mama-select-all');
    if (selectAll) {
      selectAll.addEventListener('change', function() {
        var checked = selectAll.checked;
        document.querySelectorAll('.mama-row-select').forEach(function(cb) {
          cb.checked = checked;
          setRowSelected(cb.getAttribute('data-key'), checked);
        });
      });
    }

    // Give the leaflet widget a moment to finish initializing before we
    // build the first key->layer index.
    setTimeout(rebuildLayerIndex, 300);

    // The map (checkboxes) and this search box share the same crosstalk
    // group, so subscribing to the FilterHandle gives us the *combined*
    // set of currently-matching keys, whichever control changed it. This
    // always reflects the FULL filtered list -- pagination is applied
    // separately, on top of it, inside refreshTable().
    filterHandle.on('change', function(e) {
      var visible = e.value === null ? allKeys : e.value;
      filterMatchKeys = new Set(visible);
      currentPage = 1;
      refreshTable();
    });

    if (input) {
      input.addEventListener('input', function() {
        var q = input.value.trim();
        if (!q) { filterHandle.clear(); return; }
        var hits = fuse.search(q).map(function(r) { return r.item.key; });
        filterHandle.set(hits);
      });
    }

    // --- Click-to-sort table headers ---
    var currentSort = { col: null, asc: true };
    document.querySelectorAll('#mama-results-table th.mama-sortable').forEach(function(th) {
      th.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var col = parseInt(th.getAttribute('data-col'), 10);
        var asc = currentSort.col === col ? !currentSort.asc : true;
        currentSort = { col: col, asc: asc };

        document.querySelectorAll('#mama-results-table th.mama-sortable').forEach(function(h) {
          h.textContent = h.textContent.replace(/ [\\u25B2\\u25BC]$/, '');
        });
        th.textContent = th.textContent + (asc ? ' \\u25B2' : ' \\u25BC');

        var tbody = document.querySelector('#mama-results-table tbody');
        var rows = Array.from(tbody.querySelectorAll('tr'));
        rows.sort(function(a, b) {
          var aCell = a.children[col], bCell = b.children[col];
          var aVal = aCell.getAttribute('data-sort') || '';
          var bVal = bCell.getAttribute('data-sort') || '';
          var aNum = parseFloat(aVal), bNum = parseFloat(bVal);
          var cmp;
          if (aVal !== '' && bVal !== '' && !isNaN(aNum) && !isNaN(bNum)) {
            cmp = aNum - bNum;
          } else {
            if (aVal === '') return 1;   // blanks always sort last
            if (bVal === '') return -1;
            cmp = aVal.localeCompare(bVal);
          }
          return asc ? cmp : -cmp;
        });
        rows.forEach(function(r) { tbody.appendChild(r); });
        currentPage = 1;
        refreshTable();
      });
    });

    refreshTable();
  });
"))
```
